summary: BioNTech SE filed a routine Form 6-K on August 20, 2026, announcing that it will present new clinical data at the IASLC 2026 World Conference on Lung Cancer in Seoul from September 12-15, 2026. The disclosure covers pipeline updates for pumitamig and gotistobart, including a novel-novel combination trial, with no corporate transaction, shareholder action, or strategic review involved. The filing serves only to furnish a press release as Exhibit 99.1 and is not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics are stated.
